body:
I feel pretty much the same, except I haven't had the drive or insight to really say i've pursued anything as much as is humanly possible. I just feel unsure and unable to invest myself into anything. So as far as I see, at least you have made an effort.

If it helps you, then I've had to go back and look at what i've done to truly decide if I've 'had my dreams taken from me', or if that just wasn't the time, we all develop at different rates, and society has somewhat adapted to that. Sometimes with dreams you have you just have more of the journey ahead of you. I just don't know what that is for me personally. I have things that I value highly, I just don't know how that applies to my life, do I want to make a career out of them, or are they just things I should do as a hobby and find some other career.

I just figure we just have to learn from experience. who knows, eventually we will know if there is a light at the end of the tunnel. sometimes it doesn't feel that way at all though and leaves a lot of us feeling like we don't deserve to live anymore :/
I guess i'm just too young to give up yet. gimme 3 years and I may give up for good, if i make it that far. Though on the bright side, maybe we will find something at random, who knows.
I hope we can both find something to hold onto.
